claims.text: Clusters were extracted using the k-means algorithm initialized with 'k-means++'.
The clustering process involved running the k-means algorithm for 300 iterations and selecting the result that minimizes cluster inertia.
The number of clusters was optimized, with best results typically found between 250 and 1000 classes.
Word embeddings were clustered to improve performance in various tasks, including sentiment classification.
